cases.note: A body declaring one role on two joints is a descriptor bug, and `indexTarget` keeps the first because silently preferring the later one would make the mapping depend on array order. The two joints are rated 80 and 60 Nm, so which one wins is visible in the binding's target and in its limit — until this case existed, last-wins produced identical bytes everywhere.
cases.expected: {"bindings":[{"limit":80,"method":"remap","reason":"Mapped by role right_arm.elbow.flex to \"J1\".","scale":1,"source_index":0,"source_role":"right_arm.elbow.flex","target":"J1"}],"clamp":{"joint_modes":{"J1":"torque"},"joint_torque_max_nm":80,"joint_velocity_max_rad_s":2,"min_control_hz":10,"per_channel":{"J1":80},"source":"https://example.invalid/arm.pdf"},"control_hz":50,"control_mode":"torque","observations":[],"robot_slug":"test-duplicate-role","source_digest":"sha256:policy","target_digest":"sha256:arm","verdict":"direct","warnings":[{"code":"unmapped_roles","message":"1 joint on this body is not driven by the policy and will be held by the controller.","subjects":["right_arm.wrist.roll"]}]}

cases.note: The SO-101 policy on the importer's UR, which is the mismatch F177 filed. A remap, and the reason names the equivalence it relied on, so an integrator can see the assertion; the body's elbow is not reported as a joint the policy left alone.
cases.expected: {"bindings":[{"limit":60,"method":"remap","reason":"Mapped by role right_arm.elbow.flex to \"elbow_joint\" (flex ≡ pitch on the elbow).","scale":1,"source_index":0,"source_role":"right_arm.elbow.flex","target":"elbow_joint"}],"clamp":{"joint_modes":{"elbow_joint":"torque"},"joint_torque_max_nm":80,"joint_velocity_max_rad_s":2,"min_control_hz":10,"per_channel":{"elbow_joint":60},"source":"https://example.invalid/arm.pdf"},"control_hz":50,"control_mode":"torque","observations":[],"robot_slug":"test-ur-like","source_digest":"sha256:policy","target_digest":"sha256:ur-like","verdict":"direct","warnings":[{"code":"dof_mismatch","message":"The policy was trained on a 3 degree-of-freedom body; this one has 4."},{"code":"unmapped_roles","message":"3 joints on this body are not driven by the policy and will be held by the controller.","subjects":["right_arm.shoulder.pitch","right_arm.wrist.pitch#0","right_arm.wrist.pitch#1"]}]}

cases.note: And the other way round: a G1 policy writes `elbow.pitch`, the SO-101 body says `elbow.flex`. The rule is an equivalence, not a preference for either spelling.

cases.note: The rule stops at the links with one bend. A shoulder has a `pitch` and no `flex`, so a policy asking for the second is refused by a body that has the first — and the reason is the unchanged sentence, not an equivalence that was tried and failed.
cases.expected: {"bindings":[{"limit":null,"method":"blocked","reason":"This body has no right_arm.shoulder.flex and the policy requires it.","scale":1,"source_index":0,"source_role":"right_arm.shoulder.flex","target":null}],"clamp":{"joint_torque_max_nm":80,"joint_velocity_max_rad_s":2,"min_control_hz":10,"per_channel":{},"source":"https://example.invalid/arm.pdf"},"control_hz":50,"control_mode":"torque","observations":[],"robot_slug":"test-ur-like","source_digest":"sha256:policy","target_digest":"sha256:ur-like","verdict":"refused","warnings":[{"code":"dof_mismatch","message":"The policy was trained on a 3 degree-of-freedom body; this one has 4."},{"code":"retarget_without_solver","message":"Task-space retargeting would be required, and was not requested.","subjects":["right_arm"]},{"code":"unmapped_roles","message":"4 joints on this body are not driven by the policy and will be held by the controller.","subjects":["right_arm.shoulder.pitch","right_arm.elbow.pitch","right_arm.wrist.pitch#0","right_arm.wrist.pitch#1"]}]}

cases.note: Three roles on one leg: `knee` and `ankle` are hinge links and `hip` is not. The policy's knee and ankle bind the body's `pitch` joints; its hip `flex` — a third word for a ball joint's bend — is refused, so the verdict is blocked and the other two bindings show what bound.

cases.note: The two hinge links the arm and leg cases do not reach, at ordinals that are not zero. The policy's `finger.flex#2` is the body's `finger.pitch#2` and its `knuckle.flex#1` the body's `knuckle.pitch#1` — and neither is the joint at `#0`, which a swap that dropped or reset the ordinal would have bound.
